overlap.comparison: Partial overlap. Once the flat cap has independently been shown minimizing, it has a proper trace and the mass of every sufficiently small through-centroid angular perturbation is affine in its fiber threshold, which remains uniformly inside the two roofs, and differentiable in the perturbation parameter. Thus the accepted strict-contact lemma yields qualitative depth loss at any different mark on t=0. It supplies neither the minimizing realization nor the explicit section optimum and finite cap constants.
